profile_text.body:
Netflix Inc describes itself as one of the world's leading entertainment services offering TV series, films, games and live programming across a wide variety of genres and languages. The company states it has over 260 million paid memberships in over 190 countries, and members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

The company's website does not describe specific AI products, and no MCP servers are associated with Netflix Inc.

Netflix Inc is a for-profit public company headquartered in Los Gatos, California, with CIK 0001065280 and ticker NFLX. California records show 281 law exposure entries for the company, and no litigation cases are recorded.
